body:
**Independent exact replay of this pull request's certificate** ($C_{82} \le 0.2536331090204145$, the 82a row [Gri26]), with our own code. Only data were downloaded (maaxgrin/zhang-zagier-c82-bound @ `cb88f92`): the record `qstar_lp_grid32768_maxden1e7` of `runs/qstar_targeted_refined.jsonl`, which is the candidate the certified run `runs/qstar_cert_roots_262144_target253635.jsonl` names; `zzopt/` and the tests were neither read nor run.

| check | result |
|---|---|
| the data | denominator $Q = Q_1Q_2R_0R_2P_7P_9$ (degree $D = 140$, all monic), numerators $P_1,\dots,P_6,P_8$ with exponents such as $q_1 = 56823994/2143341$; $\deg A = 0.8946\,D < D$; all 42 numerator-denominator pairs coprime |
| $\log M(Q\circ T)$ | $35.4992299049\ldots$, every root of every $F\circ T$ (354 of them) in a certified disc |
| $\int_0^1 \max(0, g)$ | $[0.00853891, 0.00853894]$, by adaptive panels, with Jensen's formula as a self-test |
| the bound | $B \in [0.2536269201610, 0.2536269202552]$ (first program) and $[0.2536269162788, 0.2536269293400]$ (second), both below 0.2536331090204145 by $6.2\cdot10^{-6}$ |

**How.** The two separately written programs we used for the C82 certificates of #280 and #330: one encloses the roots by Gershgorin discs and integrates with per-root series on dyadic panels in fixed-point integers; the other certifies roots by a Newton inclusion with exact Gaussian-integer evaluation and integrates with Taylor polynomials in the panel variable. Both check the hypotheses (monic denominators, $\deg A < D$, coprimality) before anything else.

**Red controls**, refused: a bound just below our enclosure; $P_7$ added as a numerator (coprimality fails); $P_7$ doubled (not monic); the exponents scaled so that $\deg A = D + 1$.

The row prints the repository's certified interval bound, which is $6\cdot10^{-6}$ above $B$; the README's numerical value for this $Q$, 0.253626920959, is $7\cdot10^{-10}$ above our enclosure (information only). We have no connection with the author.

**Re-derive** from https://github.com/arhancanli/quantavane-replays/tree/cc8d0318623caaf746d3b90c04abe26bbe965733 (folder `c82gri`, with `c82` and `c82v6`): `./fetch.sh && ./run_all.sh` (Python 3.9+; about a minute). Prepared with AI assistance (Claude, Anthropic).
